TWR: the producer's arithmetic label (time-weighted, daily geometric); the V / fee / price method is NOT in the label but in the manifest's valuation_source/fee_treatment/price_basis read from the sources.json entry (ADDENDUM 13.1), so the label states no custodian method
HOLDINGS_INCOME_FALLBACK: the withdrawn guard substitution (PRD ruling 17, 'never emitted'); FWD-3 is not a fallback and is not holdings-price-plus-income
NOT_MEASURABLE: says there is no number; true only on a blank day, where it is used

sample_day_manifest.method: r_t = (V_t - F_t) / V_(t-1) - 1; the valuation source, fee treatment and price basis are the declared fields valuation_source=positions_x_as_traded_close, fee_treatment=net_of_fees, price_basis=as_traded, and no further method is stated for this source; daily returns link geometrically. GIPS-ALIGNED, not GIPS-compliant.

columns_null.income_received: FWD-3 does not separate income (inside the value through the cash leg); no _reason column exists
columns_null.fee_amount: FWD-3 is after fees (a drag inside the return); reason FEE_RAIL_UNUSED is the producer's only admitted reason
columns_null.method_version: NULL on purpose: the producer's version 2 names the custodian equity as V

NO_HOLDINGS_ROW.text: On these rows NO_HOLDINGS_ROW (holdings_price_return_reason) means that no holdings row exists UNDER THIS ACCOUNT ID FORM. The two account id forms were not joined on any of the 75 neighbour days (0 of 75 joined), so the holdings cross-check therefore graded 0 of 1,691,729 rows. A reader must not take it as "the account held nothing".
